_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), by how many things change from the first figure to the second. 1: one change (a turn, a shape moving round, lines added); 2: two changes; 3: three changes, or a flip that moves several parts; 4: each shape moving by its own rule, or four or more changes at once. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
